newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks seen mixed to lower.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks seen mixed to lower.

text.p: Wall Street stocks are expected to opened mixed to lower at the start of trading Thursday in a follow-through from Wednesday's fall.
Analysts said investors also would be looking past jobless claims due out at 1230 GMT to Friday's disclosure of March producer prices and retail sales figures.
Those numbers could help the Federal Reserve decide on its next move to raise interest rates.
"I would expect a slight down opening, pretty much in sympathy with yesterday," said Thom Brown, managing director of Rutherford Brown and Catherwood.
"Yesterday was not a very impressive performance at the end of the day."
The Dow industrials closed down 45.32 at 6,563.84, ending a three-day rebound. The Nasdaq composite index was off 7.94 at 1249.43.
Hildegard Zagorski, an analyst at Prudential Securities, said, "I think the bound kind of ran out of steam. That bounce that we had was on low volume, so it was a little bit suspicious."
